_doc: P-541 planner blast fixtures — hand-stamped spec truth. When this gate goes red the ENGINE is on trial, never the fixture (unless the owner changed the spec on record).

scenarios.desc: R200 for 7 dinners: 'cook once, eat twice' repeats each dish before the next; budget held to the cent
Zero budget: no meal planned, honest budget-limited warning (0 >= 0.95x0)
Exact-fit week: 2x c1 + 1x c2 lands exactly on R120 -> 'over' band
90% band edge: R40 spent of R44 (4000/4400 > 0.9) -> amber 'near'
Under band: R40 of R50 (4000 < 4500) -> green 'under'
P-307 utilization: greedy takes cheap R40, upgrade pass swaps to realCount-3 R60 within budget
Budget far too small (R5 vs R40 meal): 0 meals, variety-flavored warning (spend < 95%)
Pack-rounding honesty: 250g need rounds to a 400g pack (R40) -> R30 budget can't afford it
Same rounding at R40 budget: charged for the WHOLE pack, long shelf -> no waste report
Pantry offsets the gap: 150g stock + 250g need -> buys 1 pack, stock valued proportionally
Empty pantry week: repeats pack-share; every line bought, no pantry-use rows
Fully-stocked week: R0 shop, all plate value from the kitchen
P-306 hole fix: shared 500g stock consumed ONCE; the second meal (tie->repeat) buys its own pack
Partial coverage buys only the true gap (100g stock, 300g need -> still 1 pack, stock valued)
Staple-tier lines (tier 0 <= 0.5) are assumed-home: never bought, never consume stock
Garbage pantry rows (negative/zero/string qty) skipped, not trusted (P-308)
Unconvertible 'unit' lines: 3 loose pantry ROWS consumed once each; 4th meal count-buys a pack
Pantry-use value is proportional to pack price (400g of a 2000g/R60 pack = R12)
Relief decides day 3: eater eff R36.50 (R39 - 0.25x(1/3xR30)) beats plain R37; starter's near-free repeat takes days 1-2
Long-shelf (365d) spinach gets NO relief: eater stays R39 -> plain (R37) wins day 3
Shelf-2 spinach: day-3 freshness negative -> floored to 0 relief -> plain wins; the 300g surplus is then REPORTED as waste (vs C01 where the eater eats it) — relief is honesty, not a subsidy
Waste honesty: 100g used of a 400g 3-day pack -> USE SOON reports 300g worth R30
Long-shelf surplus stays silent: 365d item -> no USE SOON block
USE SOON value proportional: 150g of a 500g/R50 5-day pack -> 350g worth R35
Recency bench: stew cooked 5d ago sits out; curry takes the day
Repeater exemption: a deliberate repeater (in the log >=3x) still plans despite recency
Holes beat repeats: one recipe, 3 days -> exactly 2 (MAX_REPEATS), day 3 honest hole
A fresh repeat always beats a benched recent: same recipe twice, recent never returns
applyPick honors MAX_REPEATS: a recipe already placed twice is rejected with 'repeat-cap'
The repeater exemption lifts the bench but NOT the cap: still max 2 of the same
applyPick unknown recipe -> {ok:false, reason:'unknown-recipe'}
Servings 2->4 scales 200g->400g; meal VALUE is proportional (R32), shop charge pack-exact (R40)
Tier-mixed slip: e1 repeats (R30 x2 packs), v1 once -> split R40 verified / R60 estimated + footer
Tier normalizer: legacy 'estimate' spelling counts as estimated, never verified
WhatsApp 48-char cap: a 50-char name truncates with ellipsis, no line ever exceeds 48

scenarios.desc: Slip contract shape: header, week block, total, savings line all present in order
Offline regenerate: [c1,c1,c2] -> clear day 3 -> repick c2 -> byte-identical plan (sheet replay + pantry re-consumption land on the same totals)
dayOptions ranks cheapest-first and flags the over-budget pick with the exact overrun
Savings math: same dish twice packs into 2 packs (R80) -> saved R140 vs the R55/plate baseline
Empty dinner pool honesty: lunch-only candidates -> the no-dinner warning, 0 meals
Status band edge at exactly 90%: R36 spent of R40 -> 'near' (display rounding never flips a band)
